settings.title: Settings
settings.language.label: Language
settings.clearIntermediatesHelp: Delete images that are not shown in the gallery, such as canvas staging results.
settings.resetWebUiHelp: Puts the chosen part back to how it was at first. Pictures, models, comics and the canvas are kept.
settings.resetDone: Web UI has been reset. Reload to apply.
settings.hotkeys.title: Hotkeys
settings.about.title: About novira
settings.about.mockNote: Running in mock mode. Generated images are synthetic samples; nothing touches disk or the network.
settings.hotkeys.app.invokeFrontDesc: Add to the front of the queue
settings.hotkeys.app.clearQueueDesc: Remove every item from the queue
settings.hotkeys.app.toggleLeftPanelDesc: Show or hide the left panel
settings.hotkeys.app.toggleRightPanelDes: Show or hide the gallery (the right panel)
settings.hotkeys.canvas.decBrushDesc: Make the brush or eraser smaller
settings.hotkeys.canvas.incBrushDesc: Make the brush or eraser larger
settings.hotkeys.canvas.quickSwitchDesc: Switch with the previously used tool
settings.hotkeys.gallery.starDesc: Star or unstar the selected images
settings.hotkeys.viewer.remixDesc: Recall all parameters except the seed
settings.hotkeys.workflows.deleteNodeDes: Delete the selected nodes and edges
settings.hotkeys.workflows.undoDesc: Undo the last change in the node editor
settings.theme.label: Theme
settings.civitaiKey.label: Civitai API key
settings.civitaiKey.help: Used to download models that need a login. It is saved encrypted on this PC and never shown.
settings.civitaiKey.failed: Could not save the API key
settings.hfToken.label: Hugging Face token
settings.hfToken.help: Used to download gated models that need access approval. It is saved encrypted on this PC and never shown.
settings.about.oss.title: Open source
settings.about.oss.intro: novira uses the following open-source software. Each belongs to its authors and is used under the license shown.
settings.about.oss.packsNote: Extensions (ComfyUI custom nodes) and models follow the license of where they come from, once installed.
settings.uiZoom.label: Zoom
settings.uiZoom.help: Size of the whole window. Ctrl + / Ctrl − change it too.
settings.hotkeys.viewer.zoomInDesc: Zoom the image in one step
settings.hotkeys.viewer.zoomOutDesc: Zoom the image out one step
settings.showDevLogHelp: Adds a log button to the sidebar with the backend's log, warnings and uncaught errors.
settings.lowMemory.label: Low-memory mode
settings.lowMemory.help: For GPUs with little memory. Models are not kept in GPU memory, so generating is slower. Switching restarts ComfyUI.
settings.lowMemory.pending: A job is running, so it applies the next time ComfyUI starts.
settings.lowMemory.external: novira is connected to a ComfyUI started elsewhere, so this setting has no effect.
settings.about.packs.title: Installed extensions
settings.hotkeys.canvas.nudgeDesc: With the Move tool, moves the selected layer by 1 px (10 px with Shift)
settings.hotkeys.canvas.pasteDesc: Adds the picture on the clipboard as a new raster layer
settings.hotkeys.canvas.randomPoseDesc: With the Pose tool, gives the poses of the selected control layer a new random shape
settings.about.license.title: License
settings.about.license.intro: novira is distributed under the Apache License 2.0. Its full text follows.
settings.about.license.failed: The license text could not be loaded.
settings.hotkeys.comic.undoDesc: Takes back the last change to the text, layout, balloons or poses
settings.hotkeys.comic.redoDesc: Brings back a change that was taken back
settings.hotkeys.comic.deleteDesc: Deletes the selected balloon, or takes the selected picture out of its panel
settings.hotkeys.comic.nudgeDesc: Moves the selected picture by 1% of its panel's width (10% with Shift)
settings.comicFont.label: Default balloon font
settings.startTab.label: Tab to open at start
settings.toastSeconds.label: Seconds a notification stays
settings.undoLimit.label: Undo steps
settings.undoLimit.help: How many edits can be undone in the canvas, comic, text and workflow editors. More steps use more memory.
settings.textFont.label: Default text font
settings.comicPage.help: New comics and the pages you add start like this. Pages you already have do not change.
settings.reset.scope.label: What to reset
settings.reset.scope.settingsHelp: Puts the language, the theme and the other settings of this dialog back to how they were at first, at once.
settings.reset.scope.generationHelp: Puts the prompts, the model and the parameters of the generation screen back to how they were at first. It applies after a reload.
settings.reset.scope.galleryHelp: Puts the gallery display (thumbnail size, order and so on) back to how it was at first. It applies after a reload.
settings.reset.scope.assistantHelp: Deletes every chat with the agent. It applies after a reload.
settings.reset.scope.allHelp: Puts every setting and screen state saved in the browser back to how it was at first. Presets, characters, prompt lists and the agent chats are deleted too. It applies after a reload.
settings.section.engineWhere: Where the data and the engine are
settings.engine.dataDir.label: Data folder
settings.engine.dataDir.help: The folder that holds your pictures, models, the image engine and so on. It cannot be changed here.
settings.engine.comfyui.label: Image engine (ComfyUI)
settings.engine.comfyui.ownedHelp: The app starts the ComfyUI it installed in the data folder.
settings.engine.comfyui.otherHelp: The ComfyUI named in the settings file is used. It cannot be changed here.
settings.engine.package.label: ComfyUI package
settings.engine.package.help: The kind used the next time ComfyUI is downloaded (the first install or a change of version), or when the installed ComfyUI is changed to another kind.
settings.engine.timeout.label: Seconds to wait for the start
settings.engine.timeout.help: How long to wait for ComfyUI to answer after starting it. Make it longer on a slow computer.
settings.engine.civitai.label: Look up models on Civitai
settings.engine.civitai.help: Looks up each local model by its file hash to get its picture and license. The hash of every model file is sent to Civitai, so this is off by default. Applies at the next start.
settings.engine.modelRoots.label: Folders searched for models
settings.engine.modelRoots.help: Folders searched for models besides models in the data folder. The folder layouts of ComfyUI and Stability Matrix are understood. Up to 16 can be added.
settings.engine.restart: The changes are used from the next time the app starts.
settings.engine.failed: Could not change the engine settings
settings.assistantRead.label: Reading pictures and prompts
settings.assistantRead.help: Whether the agent may read how the gallery's pictures were made (their prompts and more) and the prompts of the Generate tab. With Ask each time, it asks in the chat whenever it wants to read them.
settings.unfinished.title: Partial files
settings.unfinished.help: When a download stops halfway, the part already received stays in the data folder. The next time the same download starts, it continues from this file. If you delete it, that download starts again from the beginning. A file in use is not deleted and stays.
settings.unfinished.deleteFailed: The partial files could not be deleted
settings.unfinished.loadFailed: The partial files could not be read
settings.engine.package.reinstall: The next time novira starts (or the engine is restarted), ComfyUI is installed again with the chosen package. The download is large and takes a while. The ComfyUI version stays the same, and the extensions are installed again.
settings.about.oss.textAtHomepage: This software is not bundled with the app, so read its full license on its homepage.
settings.about.oss.openMock: Pages are not opened in the mock
settings.assistantWeb.label: Looking things up on Wikipedia
settings.assistantWeb.help: Whether the agent may look up facts the story needs (a period, clothing, a place, a trade) on Wikipedia. A lookup sends a short search phrase over the internet to Wikipedia. This is separate from reading pictures. With Ask each time, it shows you the search words in the chat and asks before it looks.
settings.draftCount.label: Drafts at first
settings.hotkeys.canvas.fitBboxDesc: Fit the bounding box around the visible layers
settings.draftPosition.label: Draft position at first (%)
settings.waitForEngine.label: Wait for the image engine at start-up
settings.waitForEngine.help: When off, the app opens while the engine is still loading. Its state shows in a banner.
